T4.9.message: The note says 'So His only ornament is both: plain ash, and His greatness' (hi: 'उनका एकमात्र आभूषण'). The verse (vibhūtyaṅgabhūṣam) and the cited mw-vibhuti.md entry only support ash as the ornament of His body. Nothing in the evidence says it is His only ornament, and Śiva's usual iconography includes other ornaments such as the moon and serpents. The same 'only' also appears in the bhavartha in both languages. This may be meant as poetic framing, but as written it reads as a factual claim stronger than the text supports.
T4.9.suggested_fix: Drop 'only' / 'एकमात्र': 'So the ornament on His body is both: plain ash, and His greatness.' / 'इसलिए उनके अंगों का आभूषण दोनों है: ...'
